description:

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often achieve strong accuracy on benchmarks, yet it remains unclear how reliably they apply this knowledge when the same question is phrased in different but equivalent ways. arXiv:2607.22564v1 Announce Type: new

This paper presents a loss-aware feature-map pruning framework using multi-armed bandits.
